title: Sony TV Remote Replacement: Match, Compare, Test
description: Match a replacement Sony TV remote to your model code, see prices read at three Vietnamese sellers on 26 November 2026, and know what to test before you pay.
h1: Sony TV remote replacement in Vietnam: match the model, compare sellers and test before you pay
intro: To find the right Sony TV remote replacement, read the model code on the label on the back of your TV, then check three things before you pay: compatibility, every button and the remote's condition. Prices for the same kind of remote differ several times over between sellers, so compare at least two. A voice remote also has to pair with the TV over Bluetooth, so try it on the spot.
keyPoints: The TV's model code (for example KD43X8300C) decides which remote will work. FPT Shop and Hoàng Hà Mobile both advise giving that code to the seller and bringing the old remote along.
On 26 November 2026, Điện máy XANH listed a basic Sony replacement remote at {{vnd:80000}} and baohanhsony.vn listed the RMF-TX310P voice remote at {{vnd:490000}}, out of stock.
Universal and cheap compatible remotes usually handle only the basics. The mic and Google Assistant buttons work only once a remote has paired with the TV over Bluetooth.
On Google TV sets such as the BRAVIA 6, Sony's help guide says to re-pair by holding HOME and BACK for about 3 seconds with the remote within 1 metre of the TV.
While you wait for a new remote, the Google TV phone app can control an Android TV or Google TV Sony set, as long as both are on the same Wi-Fi network.
Sony does not cold-call people to sell discounted remotes. Điện máy XANH warned about this scam in 2019.

sections.title: How do I find my Sony TV model number and remote code?

blocks.text: Your Sony TV's model code is on the label on the back of the set, and newer TVs also show it in the Settings menu. That code is what you match a remote against. FPT Shop says to give the model code to the shop staff, and Hoàng Hà Mobile says to bring the old remote too, so the seller can find an equivalent.

A Sony TV remote is the controller Sony makes for a particular range of BRAVIA TVs. Each genuine remote works with a set list of TV models, and the remote has its own code (such as RMF-TX310P), separate from the TV's. Note down both.

items.title: Read the label on the back of the TV
items.text: Find the model code, which on Sony sets starts with letters such as KD or KDL followed by the screen size, as in KD43X8300C or KDL55W800C. Take a photo of the label so you don't get the letters at the end wrong.

items.title: Check the menu if the label is unreadable
items.text: According to [Điện máy XANH](https://www.dienmayxanh.com/kinh-nghiem-hay/cach-xem-ten-smart-tivi-sony-va-android-tivi-sony-1087750), on 2018 Sony Android TVs you press Home, open Settings and choose About. On 2018 Sony Smart TVs you open Settings and choose Customer Support. Menu names can differ on other years.

items.title: Turn the old remote over
items.text: Look on the back and inside the battery compartment of the old remote for its code. Even if the remote no longer works, that code is the quickest way for a seller to find the right one.

items.title: Compare with the compatibility list
items.text: A good remote listing names the TV models it works with. For example, the RMF-TX310P page on [baohanhsony.vn](https://baohanhsony.vn/phu-kien/dieu-khien-tv-tu-xa-rmf-tx310p/) listed more than 80 models on 26 November 2026, mostly with C, D, E, F and G suffixes. Your model must be on the list.

blocks.title: "Sony" on its own is not enough
blocks.text: Two Sony TVs with the same screen size but a different suffix on the model code can need different remotes. Ask the seller using your full model code, not "a remote for a 55-inch Sony".

sections.title: Should I buy a genuine Sony remote, a compatible one or a universal remote?

blocks.text: Buy the genuine remote for your model if you need the mic button, Google Assistant or the app shortcut buttons. If you only need power, volume and channels, a compatible or universal remote at a much lower price will do. FPT Shop and Hoàng Hà Mobile both say a universal remote may not support every function of the original.

blocks.text: Does a cheap remote labelled "voice" really do voice control?

The only way to be sure is to try the mic button on a TV. The word "voice" in a product name proves nothing. Sony's help guide says a voice remote has to be paired with the TV, and that pairing has failed if pressing the Google Assistant button does not open the voice control field. The [Hoàng Thịnh TV listing](https://hoangthinhtv.com/san-pham/remote-tv-voice-dieu-khien-tivi-sony-giong-noi-rmf-tx520p) for a "voice" remote says it can be used straight away with no setup, which is a reason to ask the seller whether the mic button actually works.
What are the signs of a poor-quality remote?

FPT Shop and Hoàng Hà Mobile list the same warning signs: batteries that drain fast, a delay before the screen responds, buttons that don't respond, and a remote that breaks after a minor drop. FPT Shop advises avoiding small sellers and roadside vendors, who are more likely to sell remotes of unknown origin.

blocks.text: The price depends on the type of remote and the seller. On the seller pages we read on 26 November 2026, prices ran from {{vnd:80000}} for a basic replacement remote to {{vnd:490000}} for the RMF-TX310P voice remote. The table shows only prices we read directly on each seller's own page.

blocks.text: According to Điện máy XANH, as of November 2026, the Cosano RM-SN01 costs {{vnd:80000}} in Ho Chi Minh City. According to Hoàng Thịnh TV, as of November 2026, the remote listed as RMF-TX520P costs {{vnd:120000}}. According to baohanhsony.vn, as of November 2026, the RMF-TX310P costs {{vnd:490000}} and is out of stock.

Hoàng Hà Mobile (article dated 15 January 2026) says genuine remotes made for a specific TV range may cost more than universal ones. So a remote with the same name at a much lower price deserves a closer test, not a quick handover.

Prices on Lazada, Shopee, TikTok Shop and second-hand listings change daily, so they are not in the table. Check the seller's page on the day you buy, and screenshot the listing that shows the compatible models.

sections.title: What should I check before I collect a remote?

blocks.text: Collect the remote where there is a Sony TV to test it on, ideally your own at home, and pay only after testing. That way you check all three things at once: compatibility, buttons and condition. If the seller can't come to you, ask beforehand whether they have a Sony TV you can test on. Listings often still give old district names, but since July 2025 official addresses use new ward names, so confirm the exact address.

items.title: Match the codes
items.text: Compare the code printed on the remote with the one the seller gave you and with the compatibility list you screenshotted.

items.title: Fit new batteries
items.text: Use fresh batteries. FPT Shop says weak batteries make a remote work only up close or need several presses, and they can also make Bluetooth pairing fail.

items.title: Try every button
items.text: Press power, volume, channel, the arrow keys, OK, Back, Home and the app buttons in turn. Step back a few metres to test the range.

items.title: Pair and test the mic
items.text: For a voice remote, pair it with the TV and press the mic or Google Assistant button. If the voice control field opens, pairing worked.

items.title: Check the casing
items.text: Make sure the battery cover fits, the battery springs aren't rusty and no buttons are worn blank or sunken. Ask whether the seller accepts returns, and for how long.

blocks.text: How do I pair a Sony voice remote with the TV?

On Google TV sets such as the BRAVIA 6, hold HOME and BACK together for about 3 seconds, with the remote within 1 metre of the TV, until the remote's light blinks. That is the method in [Sony's help guide](https://helpguide.sony.net/tv/nga4/v1/en-142/contents/TP1002508741.html). You can also go to Dashboard, then All settings, then Remotes and accessories, and follow the on-screen steps. Sony says to wait until the TV has fully started before pairing, or the pairing can fail.

For older sets, the RMF-TX310P page on baohanhsony.vn says to press HOME, open Settings, choose Voice Remote Control and then Activate the Mic Button. Hoàng Hà Mobile notes that a Bluetooth remote may need pairing again after a battery change or a TV reset. Infrared remotes don't need pairing.
Is the fault in the new remote or in the TV?

The easiest test is to try the remote on a different Sony TV. According to [FPT Shop](https://fptshop.com.vn/tin-tuc/dien-may/tivi-sony-khong-nhan-remote-198460), if it works there, your TV's infrared sensor may be dusty, blocked or faulty. FPT Shop also suggests unplugging the TV for 5 to 10 minutes and switching it back on before deciding the remote is faulty.

blocks.title: Sony does not phone people to sell remotes
blocks.text: In 2019, [Điện máy XANH](https://www.dienmayxanh.com/kinh-nghiem-hay/canh-giac-voi-chieu-tro-mua-dieu-khien-sony-voi-gi-1224679) warned that callers posing as Sony were offering remotes at about {{vnd:100000}} with a 2-year warranty. Sony said it ran no such promotion. If anyone calls offering a "genuine" Sony remote, don't transfer money: find a seller yourself, and read eno.vn's [safety tips for buying and selling](/safety).

sections.title: How can I control a Sony TV without a remote?

blocks.text: If your Sony TV runs Android TV or Google TV, you can use the Google TV app on an Android phone as a remote until the replacement arrives. The phone and the TV must be on the same Wi-Fi network. On older sets without a smart operating system, FPT Shop suggests using the buttons on the TV itself for power, volume and channels.

items.title: Open the Google TV app
items.text: Open the Google TV app on your Android phone and tap Connect TV near the bottom right.

items.title: Choose your TV
items.text: Select your Sony TV from the list.

items.title: Enter the code
items.text: Type in the code shown on the TV screen and confirm the pairing.

items.title: If it won't connect
items.text: According to [Google](https://support.google.com/androidtv/answer/6122465?hl=en), check both devices are on the same Wi-Fi network, then unplug the TV, wait 10 seconds, plug it back in and set up the virtual remote again.

blocks.text: Checking the TV's network in its menu needs some way to control the TV, so the app is most useful when the set was already connected to Wi-Fi. If the TV has never been on your Wi-Fi, you will need a working remote to finish setting it up.

sections.title: Finding a used Sony TV remote locally

blocks.text: A used remote with the right code makes sense when the genuine model is out of stock, as the RMF-TX310P was on baohanhsony.vn on 26 November 2026. Apply every check above. A listing with a clear photo of the code on the back of the remote is more reliable than one that just says "Sony remote".

On eno.vn you can browse the [Electronics](/c/electronics) category or [post a listing](/post) giving your TV's model code and the remote code you need. Message the seller in eno.vn chat and arrange to test the remote on a TV before you pay. eno.vn does not inspect goods or check sellers.

If you are thinking of replacing the TV instead, see [55-inch 4K TV prices and checks in Vietnam](/guides/55-inch-4k-tv-price-vietnam). To see whether a new set fits your cabinet, see [42-inch TV dimensions](/guides/42-inch-tv-dimensions).

sections.title: What this guide does not cover

items: Prices and stock at Sony's own online store in Vietnam: we did not check them for this guide, so look on Sony's site directly.
Repairing a broken remote (rubber buttons, circuit boards): ask a warranty centre or an electronics repairer.
Remotes for Sony soundbars, receivers or projectors: those are different products, and this guide covers TV remotes only.
Remotes for other TV brands: Hoàng Hà Mobile also advises against using a Sony remote on another brand's TV.

faqs.q: How much is a replacement Sony TV remote in Vietnam?
faqs.a: A replacement Sony TV remote in Vietnam varies several times over in price by type and seller. On seller pages read on 26 November 2026, the Cosano RM-SN01 basic replacement at Điện máy XANH was the cheapest, while the RMF-TX310P voice remote on baohanhsony.vn cost far more and was out of stock. The exact figures are in the price table above. Compare at least two sellers before buying.

faqs.q: How do I know which remote fits my Sony TV?
faqs.a: A Sony TV remote fits your TV when your TV's model code, printed on the label on the back of the set, appears in that remote's compatibility list. Photograph the label, note the code on your old remote, and compare both with the model list on the seller's page. The surest check is pressing every button on your own TV before you pay.

faqs.q: Will any Sony remote work on any Sony TV?
faqs.a: A Sony remote from another range is only certain to work if your TV is on that remote's compatibility list. Many remotes handle power and volume across several years of Sony TVs, but the mic, Google Assistant and app buttons may not work. FPT Shop suggests asking a Sony warranty centre for a newer compatible remote when the original model is discontinued.

faqs.q: Why won't my Sony voice remote pair with the TV?
faqs.a: A Sony voice remote must pair with the TV over Bluetooth before the mic button works. Sony's BRAVIA 6 help guide says to hold HOME and BACK together for about 3 seconds with the remote within 1 metre of the TV. If pairing still fails, fit fresh batteries, because weak ones can stop pairing, and try again once the TV has fully started.

faqs.q: Can I use my phone as a Sony TV remote?
faqs.a: A Sony TV running Android TV or Google TV can be controlled with the Google TV app on an Android phone. According to Google, the phone and the TV must be on the same Wi-Fi network. Open the app, tap Connect TV, choose the TV and enter the code shown on screen. Older Sony sets without a smart system need the buttons on the TV itself.

faqs.q: Does a universal remote work with a Sony TV?
faqs.a: A universal remote works with a Sony TV for basic functions such as power, volume and channels. According to Điện máy XANH, the Cosano RM-SN01 works with most Sony TVs for basic functions only. FPT Shop and Hoàng Hà Mobile say a universal remote may not support every function of the original Sony remote, such as voice control.

faqs.q: Is it worth buying a used Sony TV remote?
faqs.a: A used Sony TV remote is worth buying when it has the right code and the new model is out of stock, provided you can test it before paying. Meet the seller where there is a Sony TV, fit fresh batteries, press every button, and pair it and try the mic if it is a voice remote. Check the battery cover, springs and buttons too.
